fields.title: El Salvador (COMPRASAL) tender/award record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). 'open' mode records use COMPRASAL's own 'procesos/disponibles' fields (institucion is a plain string here); 'awarded' mode records use its 'procesos/publicos' fields (institucion is an object here, and beneficiario/proveedor/accionistas carry supplier and declared beneficial-owner data); 'detail' mode records (and open/awarded with fetchDetail=true) also carry the fuller 'detalle' object fields. Field shapes vary by mode -- this is COMPRASAL's own API shape, passed through close to verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The filters used to produce this record ('open'/'awarded' mode, an object) or the numeric process ID fetched ('detail' mode, an integer) -- shape varies by mode, so no type is enforced here.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-comprasal-api-disponibles (an open-tender record), S1-comprasal-api-publicos (an awarded/historical record), S1-comprasal-api-detalle (a fetched detail record), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search/filter matched nothing), blocked_or_transient (network/server issue after retries).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present only on an 'open'/'awarded' record with fetchDetail=true, when the detail fetch for this specific process failed -- the list fields are still present.

id.title: Process/award ID
id.description: COMPRASAL's own numeric internal ID -- for 'open' mode this is the process ID (feed into 'detail' mode's processId); for 'awarded' mode this is the award-record ID (use proceso_compra.id instead for 'detail' mode).

nombre_proceso.title: Process name
nombre_proceso.description: Description of what is being procured.

institucion.title: Institution
institucion.description: The government institution -- a plain string in 'open' mode, an object ({id, codigo, nombre}) in 'awarded' mode.

EtapaPorProcesos.title: Current stage(s)
EtapaPorProcesos.description: Array of the process's currently-active stage(s) with start/end datetime.

etapas.title: Full stage timeline (open mode)
etapas.description: Array of every stage in this process's lifecycle (publication, offer submission, clarifications, addenda, offer receipt, opening, etc.) with start/end datetime.

monto.title: Award amount (awarded mode)
monto.description: Amount of this specific award line, in USD (El Salvador's currency).

proceso_compra.title: Parent process (awarded mode)
proceso_compra.description: Object with the underlying process's id, codigo_proceso, nombre_proceso, fecha_adjudicacion, and institution.

proveedor.title: Awarded supplier (awarded mode)
proveedor.description: Object with the winning supplier's name, trade name (nombre_comercial), and shareholders (accionistas).

accionistas.title: Shareholders (awarded mode)
accionistas.description: Array of the supplier's shareholders, when disclosed.

beneficiario.title: Declared beneficial owner (awarded mode)
beneficiario.description: COMPRASAL's own declared beneficial-ownership data for the awarded supplier -- name parts and nationality, when disclosed. Rare transparency data not every country's tender system publishes.

detail.title: Full detail (when fetchDetail=true)
detail.description: The full detalle/procesos/publicos/<id> object, merged in when 'fetchDetail' was requested on an 'open'/'awarded' record.
